description: This file defines the Twig class within the Opencart system, providing functionality for managing template paths and rendering Twig templates with debugging support. It interacts with the Twig environment and loaders, handling template file resolution and rendering logic.

classes.name: Twig
classes.description: Provides methods to add template paths and render Twig templates, with internal management of loaders, directories, and rendering configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig object, setting the root directory and the default filesystem loader.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new template path or namespace to the Twig environment.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a Twig template with provided data, resolving template file paths and handling cache and extension setup.
